_comment: Your standing application profile. Onboarding writes a filled copy to user-library/profile.json. It holds your contact identity, links, and the standard answers nearly every application form asks for, so the browser auto-fill module can complete them without re-interviewing you each time. No role-specific content lives here.

compensation.notes: What to put when a form demands a number. Leave a range or 'open' if you prefer not to anchor.

standard_form_answers._comment: Verbatim answers to the recurring single-value questions on application forms. Fill what applies; leave blanks for ones you'd rather answer per-application.

library_enrichment._comment: How the kit handles new true facts about you that surface during a run (a real metric you mention, a story not yet in the fact pack, a refined role preference). 'confirm' (default) asks before saving anything. 'silent' lets the kit auto-save clearly-true additions without asking, and only checks in on ambiguous ones. Either way it NEVER invents or infers a fact you didn't actually state.

interview_recording._comment: Tool you use to transcribe interviews for the debrief step. Set tool to the app name (e.g. 'meetily', 'otter', 'fathom', 'zoom') or null if not set up. consent_tier is derived from your recording location: 'one_party' means only your own consent is required (most US states); 'two_party' means all parties must consent before recording (CA, CT, FL, IL, MD, MA, MI, MT, NH, OR, PA, WA and others — verify for your jurisdiction). Onboarding sets both fields; update if you move or change tools.
